symptoms: High latency and HTTP 500 error spikes on POST /v1/auth/login during traffic spikes.
error_log:
org.postgresql.util.PSQLException: FATAL: remaining connection slots are reserved for non-replication superuser connections
  at org.postgresql.core.v3.QueryExecutorImpl.receiveErrorResponse(QueryExecutorImpl.java:2555)
  at com.zaxxer.hikari.pool.HikariPool.checkInUseConnections(HikariPool.java:412)
metrics: HikariCP active connections: 50/50 (100%), p99 response time: 8500ms, DB connection wait queue: 142 clients.
root_cause: Database connection pool exhaustion caused by unclosed DB connections in OAuth token generation error handler.
fix: Wrapped token generator DB queries in try-with-resources block and increased maxHikariPoolSize from 50 to 100.

symptoms: Intermittent HTTP 504 Gateway Timeout when processing Stripe webhooks.
error_log: requests.exceptions.ConnectTimeout: HTTPSConnectionPool(host='api.stripe.com', port=443): Max retries exceeded with url: /v1/charges (Caused by ConnectTimeoutError)
metrics: Outbound egress packet drop rate: 12%, TCP retransmission rate: 18%, average HTTP request latency: 30000ms.
root_cause: NAT Gateway port exhaustion in AWS us-east-1 subnet due to lack of connection pooling on Stripe SDK instances.
fix: Reconfigured Stripe client SDK to reuse TCP connections via urllib3 ConnectionPool and provisioned additional NAT Gateway.

symptoms: Pod crash looping with Error status; OOMKilled events triggered across multiple Kubernetes nodes.
error_log:
java.lang.OutOfMemoryError: Java heap space
  at java.util.Arrays.copyOf(Arrays.java:3210)
  at com.acme.user.service.UserProfileService.exportAllUsers(UserProfileService.java:184)
metrics: Pod RSS memory memory_usage_bytes: 2.1GB (Limit: 2.0GB), Container restart count: 18 in 1 hour.
root_cause: Bulk export user profile endpoint executed unpaginated SQL query loading 1.5 million user rows into JVM heap.
fix: Refactored user export endpoint to stream data using cursor-based pagination and lowered batch fetch size.

symptoms: Database queries timing out on payment checkout attempts; database CPU usage pegged at 100%.
error_log:
asyncpg.exceptions.TooManyConnectionsError: sorry, too many clients already
  at asyncpg.protocol.protocol.pyx:1120
  at app.db.checkout_repo.get_cart(checkout_repo.py:88)
metrics: PostgreSQL active backend connections: 200/200, CPU utilization: 99.8%, Lock wait timeout count: 85.
root_cause: Connection pool depletion due to leaking postgres connections in abandoned shopping cart cleanup task.
fix: Ensured background cleanup worker explicitly closes connections back to asyncpg pool and added connection timeout limits.

symptoms: Search results stale; Elasticsearch bulk indexing operations failing with 429 Too Many Requests.
error_log: [2024-02-01T08:30:12,110][ERROR][o.e.a.b.TransportBulkAction] es-node-01 [search_products][0] rejected execution of org.elasticsearch.common.util.concurrent.EsAbortPolicy@1b89ef5 on EsThreadPoolExecutor[bulk, queue capacity = 200]
metrics: Elasticsearch write threadpool queue capacity: 200/200, indexing latency: 1200ms, bulk bulk_rejected index count: 14500.
root_cause: Elasticsearch indexing threadpool saturated by burst of concurrent catalog update events from catalog service.
fix: Implemented exponential backoff with jitter in bulk indexing worker and increased ES bulk queue size.

symptoms: SMS and Push notifications failing to deliver; Redis connection errors logged continuously.
error_log:
redis.exceptions.ConnectionError: Error 111 connecting to 10.0.12.45:6379. Connection refused.
  at redis.connection.Connection.connect(connection.py:614)
metrics: Redis memory usage: 100% (4.0GB maxmemory hit), evicted keys: 0 (noeviction policy), connection attempts failing.
root_cause: Redis instance ran out of memory due to unexpired notification rate-limit key buildup and 'noeviction' policy.
fix: Changed Redis maxmemory-policy to 'allkeys-lru' and enforced short TTLs on rate-limiting keys.

symptoms: Order fulfillment pipeline stalled; Postgres connection pool exhausted with high wait times.
error_log:
sqlalchemy.exc.TimeoutError: QueuePool limit of size 20 overflow 10 reached, connection timed out, timeout 30.00
  at sqlalchemy.pool.impl.QueuePool._do_get(queue.py:388)
metrics: Order DB pool utilization: 30/30 connections active, database connection acquisition delay: 30000ms.
root_cause: DB connection starvation caused by synchronous third-party inventory API call executed inside database transaction block.
fix: Moved external HTTP API call outside DB transaction block and reduced connection timeout.

symptoms: HTTP 502 Bad Gateway response on stock check API during promotional sales event.
error_log: 2024/02/14 14:02:11 [error] 14#14: *10921 upstream timed out (110: Connection timed out) while reading response header from upstream, client: 172.16.0.1, server: api.acme.com
metrics: Gunicorn worker timeout count: 42, CPU utilization: 88%, active worker processes hung on lock.
root_cause: Row-level lock contention on popular inventory product SKU items during high concurrency checkout.
fix: Optimized stock reservation using Redis atomic DECR operations before updating Postgres database records.

symptoms: Kafka consumer group lag growing exponentially; telemetry pipeline failing to ingest events.
error_log: org.apache.kafka.clients.consumer.CommitFailedException: Commit cannot be completed since the group has already rebalanced and assigned the partitions to another member.
metrics: Kafka consumer lag: 1.2M messages, max poll interval elapsed: 300,000ms, frequent consumer group rebalances.
root_cause: Long-running DB write batches exceeded max.poll.interval.ms, causing Kafka broker to declare consumer dead.
fix: Decreased max.poll.records from 500 to 100 and optimized batch insert query performance.

symptoms: Image thumbnail generation failing; disk space alert triggered on worker nodes.
error_log:
OSError: [Errno 28] No space left on device: '/tmp/magick-918231'
  at PIL.Image.save(Image.py:2310)
metrics: Root filesystem /tmp disk usage: 100% (50GB full), temp file count: 85,000 files.
root_cause: Temporary resized image artifacts in /tmp directory were not deleted after uploading to S3 object storage.
fix: Added explicit file cleanup in python finally block and setup cron job to prune /tmp directory hourly.

symptoms: Invoice generation cron job failing; TLS certificate validation errors in logs.
error_log: requests.exceptions.SSLError: HTTPSConnectionPool(host='tax-api.provider.com', port=443): SSL: CERTIFICATE_VERIFY_FAILED certificate has expired (_ssl.c:1007)
metrics: Cron execution exit code: 1, failed invoice count: 3200.
root_cause: Expired SSL CA bundle certificate in Docker base image used by billing worker.
fix: Updated base Docker image ca-certificates package and restarted billing worker daemon.

symptoms: Rates calculation API returning 500 errors for international addresses.
metrics: API Error Rate: 100% for non-US requests, request volume: 450 req/min.
root_cause: Missing key handler for optional postal_code field in international shipping address payload.
fix: Updated address parser to use dict.get('postal_code', '') with graceful fallback logic.

symptoms: High latency on homepage load; gRPC deadline exceeded errors.
error_log: grpc._channel._InactiveRpcError: <_InactiveRpcError of RPC that terminated with status StatusCode.DEADLINE_EXCEEDED, details = 'Deadline Exceeded'>
metrics: gRPC p99 latency: 5000ms (SLA: 200ms), ML model inferencing queue length: 450 requests.
root_cause: Model server GPU memory throttling due to unthrottled concurrent batch size.
fix: Enforced request concurrency throttling and model batch size limit in Triton Inference Server.

symptoms: 503 Service Unavailable returned across all public endpoints.
error_log: [error] 7#7: *1081123 no live upstreams while connecting to upstream, client: 192.168.1.1, server: _, request: 'GET /health HTTP/1.1'
metrics: Gateway HTTP 503 count: 25000/min, upstream healthy hosts: 0/12.
root_cause: Consul service discovery DNS health check probe interval misconfigured, marking all healthy pods down.
fix: Corrected Consul health check HTTP path and relaxed failure threshold.

symptoms: WebSocket disconnects across active sessions; memory usage climbing linearly.
error_log: FATAL ERROR: Ineffective mark-compacts near heap limit Allocation failed - JavaScript heap out of memory
metrics: Node.js process heap memory: 1.4GB / 1.4GB, active WebSocket connections dropped: 12,000.
root_cause: Memory leak in WebSocket event listener cleanup on client disconnect.
fix: Unsubscribed socket event listeners upon socket disconnect event and added garbage collection monitoring.
